Questions

Frequently asked questions

Is this suitable for complete beginners?

Yes. One-to-one lessons with Maria adapt to your level, and the “Swedish A1–A2” course was created specifically for beginners.

Will we speak Swedish in the lessons?

Yes, there’s speaking from the very first lessons – gradually and comfortably. The aim isn’t to “get through a topic” but to learn to use the language.

Will there be grammar?

Of course. But here grammar is a tool for communication, not an end in itself. We look at it in context, in examples and in real sentences.

Do I keep the materials after the lesson?

Yes. Maria creates her own materials – phrases, word lists, explanations – that you’ll want to come back to between lessons.

Is this suitable if I already live in Sweden?

Yes. One-to-one lessons with Maria adapt to your goals – including everyday life, paperwork, small talk and day-to-day situations in Sweden.

What format are the lessons in?

There are several formats: one-to-one lessons and lessons in pairs with Maria, Språkkafe group meetings and the book club, as well as self-study courses.

Not sure where to start?

Write to me – I’ll suggest a path to suit your level and goals.
